explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/813: Erdős and Hajnal proved n^{1/3} ≪ h(n) ≪ n^{1/2}. The Lean statement is the conjunction (n ↦ n^{1/3}) =O[atTop] h and h =O[atTop] (n ↦ n^{1/2}), with h the minimal clique number over n-vertex graphs in which every 7 vertices contain a triangle. Faithful.
